findings.title: wrangler 4.125.0 contains high-severity vulnerability via sharp/libheif
findings.detail: wrangler@4.125.0 (locked in package-lock.json, declared as ^4.123.0) pulls in miniflare which depends on sharp <0.35.4. sharp <0.35.4 has libheif vulnerabilities (GHSA-g89c-p67h-r497, GHSA-2jg2-4ch7-h545, CVE heap-buffer-overflow). Advisory: GHSA-rgj7-g3m4-5g8c. npm audit reports 3 high-severity issues (wrangler -> miniflare -> sharp). Latest wrangler is 4.131.1, which is outside the vulnerable range (4.16.0 - 4.130.0).
findings.suggested_fix: Bump wrangler from ^4.123.0 to ^4.131.1 in package.json and run npm install to update package-lock.json

findings.title: react and react-dom are one major version behind (18 vs 19)
findings.detail: package.json pins react@^18.3.1 and react-dom@^18.3.1; latest is 19.3.0. React 19 is a major release with breaking changes. No security advisory.
findings.suggested_fix: Evaluate React 19 migration guide and upgrade react/react-dom to ^19.3.0 after testing
